name: Open GSD
description: GSD web UI in native Portals, MCP tools, and automatic project and Workboard synchronization

projectSessions.description: Optional per-project destinations for factual status events and heartbeat context. Otherwise follows the default agent's configured heartbeat session.

enabled.description: Serve the existing GSD web UI in native OpenClaw Portals (default true).

packageRoot.description: Local GSD installation root; otherwise resolved from GSD_CLI_PATH or gsd on PATH.

port.description: Optional loopback web host port; otherwise an available port is selected.

embeddedProjects.description: Embedded access to the caller's native OpenClaw project catalog. By default, administrators see all caller-visible projects; an explicit projects list only narrows that catalog.

adminOnly.description: Require an administrator (default true). Non-admin access also requires an explicit projects list and native scopes exposing each project path.

projects.description: Optional narrowing allowlist, not a discovery root. Omit this property to show all caller-visible native projects; [] denies every project. Remove legacy lists to use the full native catalog.
